back: More than half of the votes cast; otherwise a run-off is held.

Why is the secret ballot important?
back: No one can know how a person voted, so voters cannot be threatened or bribed into a choice.

front: Name four features of free and fair elections.
back: Secret ballot; independent electoral commission; freedom to campaign without violence or intimidation; transparent counting watched by agents and observers.
